patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Demandbase's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Demandbase is shaped for Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, int whereas LeadIQ is shaped for Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits —. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging.; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Company-size focus: Demandbase (mid-market, enterprise) vs LeadIQ (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · LeadIQ is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools · Avoid Demandbase if you actually need LeadIQ's motion (Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
